why_it_matters: The national MOH figure (2 deaths) and press reports from Hue and Hung Yen may disagree; the burden figure for the food-safety argument depends on it
cheapest_way_to_close: Request the 2025 notifiable disease summary; check NIHE and Pasteur Institute reports

topic: wave 11 animal disease, zoonoses and pandemic risk
question: Is there a Vietnam-specific estimate of the disease burden (DALYs) of pork-borne and poultry-borne foodborne disease?
why_it_matters: Would let the study size the food-safety cost of animal protein instead of citing prevalence studies
cheapest_way_to_close: Ask ILRI Hanoi and Hanoi University of Public Health (SafePORK team) for unpublished estimates
owner_org_to_ask: ILRI Hanoi; Hanoi University of Public Health

question: What share of the protein in alternative-protein foods made in Vietnam (textured soy, chay, plant milks, blends) comes from domestic inputs, by route?
why_it_matters: Decides whether 'made in Vietnam' protein reduces import dependence or only moves it; the study's 11,000 to 17,000 t made in Vietnam (D-BENCH 2035) does not say
cheapest_way_to_close: Declaration-level customs data for HS 1208.10, 2304 (food grade), 3504, 2106.10 and 1109 by importer, plus calls to three textured-soy and chay makers on flour and protein origin
owner_org_to_ask: General Department of Customs; chay and textured-soy makers
notes: Added in v0.8 (wave 11, L3-security-exposures). Line priority: High.

question: What share of the fish eaten in Vietnam comes from capture, aquaculture and imports?
why_it_matters: If capture supplies most fish eaten at home, the policy cut of about 27% by 2030 is the largest change in protein-food supply in the study's horizon
cheapest_way_to_close: FAO FishStat production and trade plus the food balance sheet; MAE fisheries statistics on domestic use of capture landings
owner_org_to_ask: MAE Department of Fisheries and Fisheries Surveillance; FAO
notes: Added in v0.8 (wave 11, L3-security-exposures). Line priority: High.

question: Has MAE reviewed Resolution 34/NQ-CP at mid-term, and is a successor (food security after 2030) being drafted with any import-dependence, feed or protein indicator?
why_it_matters: A successor is the natural home for a protein-security indicator; Resolution 34 has none
cheapest_way_to_close: Targeted search of mae.gov.vn and vanban.chinhphu.vn; ask MAE planning department
owner_org_to_ask: MAE Department of Planning and Finance
notes: Added in v0.8 (wave 11, L3-security-exposures). Line priority: Medium.

question: Which raw materials and volumes does MAE's 2026 task 'reduce import dependence by developing domestic raw-material areas' cover (soybean, maize, cassava, other)?
why_it_matters: If it names protein crops or fermentation feedstocks with volumes, it is the first measurable official import-dependence target for protein inputs
cheapest_way_to_close: Ask MAE's Department of Livestock Production and Animal Health for the implementing plan
owner_org_to_ask: MAE Department of Livestock Production and Animal Health
notes: Added in v0.8 (wave 11, L3-security-exposures). Line priority: Medium.

question: What is the next national marine stock assessment (after 2016 to 2020), and did the standing stock keep falling?
why_it_matters: Tests whether wild fish, a quarter of animal protein supply, is still being depleted under the capture cut
cheapest_way_to_close: Research Institute for Marine Fisheries reports; NSO fisheries releases
notes: Added in v0.8 (wave 11, L3-security-exposures). Line priority: Medium.

question: How many hours of power outage a year do rural livestock farms and industrial-park fermentation plants face in southern and northern Vietnam?
why_it_matters: Tests whether domestic fermentation is less or more exposed than closed animal houses to heat and power failure
cheapest_way_to_close: EVN reliability indices (SAIDI) by province and feeder type
notes: Added in v0.8 (wave 11, L3-security-exposures). Line priority: Low.

question: Has China imposed or considered export licensing or controls on soy protein isolate, textured protein, wheat gluten or pea protein?
why_it_matters: China supplies about 84% of Vietnam's imported food plant-protein ingredient tonnage; an export control would be a direct food-protein supply shock
cheapest_way_to_close: Check China's Ministry of Commerce and General Administration of Customs export-control lists and announcements, 2020 to 2026
notes: Added in v0.8 (wave 11, L3-security-exposures). Line priority: Low.

question: Is there an official monthly pork price series behind the CPI pork sub-index, and can NSO supply it for 2019 to 2026?
why_it_matters: Annual pork CPI changes are published in NSO price releases (2020: +57.23%; 2022: minus 10.68%); a monthly series would date shocks precisely
cheapest_way_to_close: Request the pork sub-index from NSO; read NSO monthly price releases
notes: Added in v0.8 (wave 11, L3-security-exposures). Line priority: Low. Partly answers or follows OQ-164.

topic: wave 11 protein for people: food balance sheets
question: When will FAO publish the 2024 food balance sheet for Viet Nam, and does it change the direct import share of protein (19% to 23% in 2023) or the animal protein share resting on imports (61% to 71%)?
why_it_matters: Extends the protein balance past the 2025 African swine fever wave and the 2024 to 2025 rise in meat and dairy imports; chapter 1 and the key numbers quote 2023.
cheapest_way_to_close: Check the FAOSTAT catalogue (datasets_E.json) for a new FBS DateUpdate and rerun tools/build_tables.py in this folder.
notes: Added in v0.8 (wave 11, L4-protein-for-people). Line priority: Low. Partly answers or follows OQ-004.

topic: wave 11 protein for people: food balance sheets
question: Does any Vietnamese agency (NSO, MAE, NIN) compile a national food or protein balance sheet, or the FAO supply-utilisation questionnaire, and can it be published?
why_it_matters: We found none published. FAO estimates for eggs and milk look wrong (DG-174, DG-175); a national balance is the base for RM-01 (publish a national protein balance).
cheapest_way_to_close: One call or email to the NSO agriculture statistics department and the MAE planning department asking who answers the FAO questionnaire.
owner_org_to_ask: National Statistics Office; MAE Department of Planning; FAO Viet Nam
notes: Added in v0.8 (wave 11, L4-protein-for-people). Line priority: Medium.

topic: wave 11 protein for people: food balance sheets
question: What share of the soybeans used for tofu, soy milk and other soy foods in Vietnam is grown domestically, and do the main soy-food makers buy domestic beans?
why_it_matters: Soy foods carry about 181,000 t of protein a year (2023), ten times the benchmark demand path for new routes in 2035; their domestic-input share is the plant-protein security indicator that matters. Domestic output (48 kt) caps it at 9%.
cheapest_way_to_close: Two calls: Vinasoy procurement and one large tofu maker or soy-bean trader; check MAE crop data for soybean use.
owner_org_to_ask: Vinasoy; tofu makers; MAE Department of Crop Production
notes: Added in v0.8 (wave 11, L4-protein-for-people). Line priority: Medium.

topic: wave 11 protein for people: food balance sheets
question: What was the national stunting rate for children under 5 in 2024 and 2025, and is the 14.8% quoted in the press for 2025 an under-5 figure?
why_it_matters: kn-stunting uses 18% (2023). A press report quotes 14.8% for 2025, which matches the 2019 to 2020 survey rate for ages 5 to 19.
cheapest_way_to_close: One email to the National Institute of Nutrition for the nutrition surveillance table for 2024 and 2025.
notes: Added in v0.8 (wave 11, L4-protein-for-people). Line priority: Medium.

topic: wave 11 protein for people: food balance sheets
question: What protein is in the USDA feed-table lines "plant-based meal and bran" (1.83 Mt) and "other protein meals" (0.65 Mt), and how much of the latter is domestic fishmeal?
why_it_matters: Moves the imported share of compound-feed protein by about 2 points (90.4% to 94.4%); context only, it changes no conclusion.
cheapest_way_to_close: One email to USDA FAS Post in Ho Chi Minh City asking for the composition of the two lines.
owner_org_to_ask: USDA FAS Ho Chi Minh City
notes: Added in v0.8 (wave 11, L4-protein-for-people). Line priority: Low. Partly answers or follows OQ-001.

topic: wave 11 protein for people: food balance sheets
question: Why does FAOSTAT put maize food use at 1,617 kt (16.1 kg per person) in 2023 when OECD-FAO puts it at 639 kt (6.4 kg)?
why_it_matters: Changes the direct import share of protein supply by about 1 point (to 18% to 22%) and the plant-protein picture.
cheapest_way_to_close: Read the FAOSTAT supply-utilisation account (SCL) for maize in Viet Nam; ask FAO which uses are allocated to food.
notes: Added in v0.8 (wave 11, L4-protein-for-people). Line priority: Low.

topic: wave 11 imported meat, offal and dairy
question: How much of the Indian buffalo meat landed in Vietnam (about 170 to 190 kt a year) is eaten in Vietnam, and how much moves on to China or elsewhere?
why_it_matters: It decides whether about 30% or nearer 50% of the beef and buffalo meat Vietnamese people eat is imported, and so the size of the food-side import exposure in ch01 and the beef self-sufficiency in the balance model.
cheapest_way_to_close: Calls to two or three importers of Indian buffalo meat and to USDA FAS Hanoi; MOF customs data on re-exports and transit; India's APEDA destination data.
owner_org_to_ask: MOF (Customs Department); USDA FAS Hanoi; importers
notes: Added in v0.8 (wave 11, L1-meat-imports). Line priority: High.

topic: wave 11 imported meat, offal and dairy
question: Who buys imported frozen pork and mechanically deboned meat: what shares go to processors, restaurant chains, industrial kitchens and wet markets, and at what price per kg?
why_it_matters: If processors are the main buyers, blend ingredients compete with imported, not domestic, lean, which lowers the saving a blend offers (ch14, ch16).
cheapest_way_to_close: Phone calls to three importers and two processors (Vissan, Masan MEATDeli, CP, Ha Long Canfoco); importer price lists.
notes: Added in v0.8 (wave 11, L1-meat-imports). Line priority: Medium. Partly answers or follows OQ-203.

topic: wave 11 imported meat, offal and dairy
question: What are Vietnam's year-by-year preferential tariffs to 2035 on the top meat and dairy lines (0202.30, 0203.29, 0206.49, 0207.14, 0402.10, 0402.21) under CPTPP, EVFTA, RCEP, AANZFTA, AIFTA and the Vietnam to EAEU FTA?

notes: Added in v0.8 (wave 11, L1-meat-imports). Line priority: Low.

topic: wave 11 imported meat, offal and dairy
question: How is imported milk powder used in Vietnam: what shares go to reconstituted liquid milk, infant and child formula, and food ingredients?
why_it_matters: Decides how much of the milk powder import plant milks could replace; formula is not substitutable.
cheapest_way_to_close: Ask the Vietnam Dairy Association and the two largest dairy processors; check processor annual reports.

notes: Added in v0.8 (wave 11, L1-meat-imports). Line priority: Medium. Partly answers or follows OQ-239.

topic: wave 11 imported meat, offal and dairy
question: Does Russia pay transport or export-promotion subsidies on pork shipped to Vietnam, and what rate does Russian pork pay under the Vietnam to EAEU FTA?
why_it_matters: Russia is the one origin where support lowers production cost; it supplied 48% of Vietnam's pork imports in 2025.
cheapest_way_to_close: Read the Russian government's agri-export support resolutions and Vietnam's decree on the Vietnam to EAEU FTA tariff schedule.
notes: Added in v0.8 (wave 11, L1-meat-imports). Line priority: Low.

topic: wave 11 imported meat, offal and dairy
question: Is the OECD producer NPC for Vietnamese poultry (0.52 to 0.60 in 2022 to 2024) an artefact of the import unit value used as the reference price?
why_it_matters: If the reference is overstated, OECD's finding that Vietnamese poultry producers are implicitly taxed would be wrong, and the import comparison in ch01 should not use it.
cheapest_way_to_close: Ask the OECD Trade and Agriculture Directorate which import series and weights it uses for Vietnam poultry.
notes: Added in v0.8 (wave 11, L1-meat-imports). Line priority: Low.

question: What would food-grade fungal biomass protein (mycoprotein) made in Vietnam cost per tonne of protein, including the step that cuts its RNA content and food-grade hygiene?
why_it_matters: The only Vietnamese fungal cost stack (chapter 9, Appendix S12) was built for a feed-grade ingredient. Chapters 9 and 21 say food grade costs more, but no food-grade figure exists; it decides whether fungal protein fits as a food ingredient (T9, TPP-06) and the food comparison in chapter 9.
cheapest_way_to_close: Adapt the published food mycoprotein model (COST-43, Risner, McDonald and Jones 2023, USD 29.56 per kg of protein on 2022 US inputs) to Vietnamese sugar, power, labour and capital costs from Appendix S12; then ask one equipment supplier for an indicative food-grade quote.
owner_org_to_ask: AltProtein Vietnam (desk model); fermentation equipment suppliers
notes: Added in v0.8 during consolidation, to record the gap flagged in M5.14.12.
